# PK HUB

> PK HUB (pkhub.co) ขายส่งมือถือเครื่องศูนย์ไทย แท็บเล็ต และอุปกรณ์เสริมให้ร้านค้าคู่ค้าทั่วประเทศ ดำเนินการโดย บริษัท พี เค มีเดีย บิสซิเนส จำกัด ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการอยู่ที่ฉะเชิงเทรา
> PK HUB is a Thai smartphone wholesaler for retail phone shops: official Thai-warranty phones, tablets and accessories, operated by PK Media Business Co., Ltd. from Chachoengsao.

## Facts

- Products: 500+ models from 24 brands: phones and tablets from Apple, Samsung, OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi, HONOR, HUAWEI, realme, NOTHING and TECNO, and accessories from 14 brands. Models, prices and stock are confirmed by the team before each order.
- Services for partner shops: Stock on Demand, AIS SIM and top-up (AIS authorised distributor), S Leasing instalments, after-sales support.
- Documents: VAT registered; issues full tax invoices.
- Serves: retail shops across Thailand, with a focus on Chachoengsao and eastern Thailand.
- Ordering: from 1 unit, no deposit; a single model or mixed models get the same wholesale pricing. Price and stock are confirmed per order.
- Delivery: high-value phones usually ship with transport insurance; nearby shops can send a messenger (e.g. Lalamove) or pick up in Chachoengsao.
- Best sellers with partner shops: Apple (all iPhone series, most repeat orders), then vivo, OPPO and Samsung.
- Becoming a partner: apply online; wholesale access opens only after the team reviews and approves the shop.
- Address: 72/29-30 Sukprayoon Road, Na Mueang, Mueang Chachoengsao, Chachoengsao 24000, Thailand.
- Contact: +66 89 248 0888 · LINE @pkhub (https://lin.ee/VEgW6qG) · Mon–Sat 8:00–17:00.
